changeSet.author: nexus-a6mon
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_bounded: move at most p_row_limit orphan chunks to the quarantine collection per call, carry created_at through, and return (moved, sample, remaining) so a caller can loop and terminate. One call is one commit. The unbounded gc_quarantine_orphans is left untouched for the indexer's incremental prune.
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_bounded(int, text, text, text, text, int, int);
